caption: The drawing shows a rectangular panel with a light grayish background bordered by a thin, darker frame. At the top, there are a series of red and brown semicircular swags, each decorated with red lines and tassels hanging down. Below this border, the interior is divided visually into sections by vertical rows of red curved marks, creating two main columns. In the left column, there are floral patterns consisting of olive green leaves surrounding red circular centers, and additional flowery forms with only greenish elements. In the right column, two large flower-like shapes with red petals and olive-green centers are depicted, spaced with clusters of smaller green leaf patterns. The bottom section displays a curving brown-red vine with leaves running horizontally across the width of the panel. The entire composition uses a palette primarily of red, brown, olive green, and gray, arranged symmetrically and decoratively.
title: Stencilled Wall
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
